# QR decoder

`zxing-0.23.0.min.js` is the unmodified `@zxing/library` 0.23.0 UMD
`index.min.js` distribution from https://unpkg.com/@zxing/library@0.23.0/umd/index.min.js.
Its Apache-2.0 license is included in `zxing-LICENSE`.

SHA-256: `3ede94153fb0c5b67a12d7adff6decd827c2b22714fdc6faecf27a8f20937ea6`.

The scanner loads this pinned same-origin asset on demand. It must not fetch
executable decoder code from a third-party CDN in an unlocked encryption session.
